notes.title: Lucky Stamina has been released!
notes.content:
Hello, Yujin Games.

Lucky stamina has been released.You can play for free right now. Thank you!


■synopsis =======
"If there's always someone who's lucky, there might always be someone who'"

A, a normal high school student living in OOO-gu, OOO-dong. He is a lucky student. No, I'd say luck follows him.
The elevator door opens just in time, the questions are taken, the two yolks of the egg
With some lacking but overflowing luck, he was living a fairly satisfying life.

Then one day, unlike her, she meets Kim Soo-yeon  who is always unlucky, and Hwang Jin-ah  a crazy adherent of similar science.
A crossover between the lucky and the unlucky! Lucky Stamina, here we go!


■Game Information =======
Genre: Miyeonshi, Visual Nobel
Playtime: 6–8 hours
Game difficulty: ☆☆☆★★
Illustration: Pleats


※Be careful!※
Lucky Stamina has a large number of scenarios based on  Yoo Jin-sik's gag,  Yoo Jin-sik's emotions , and  Yoo Jin-sik's understanding .
The main character of Lucky Stamina is  more self-conscious  than the main character of Psycho-Jirai, and the atmosphere is  more dramatic and fluid  than the Grand Empire Amane.
Lucky Stamina has been breaking the Fourth Wall all the time, including Hi*mi and all kinds of drivel, nonsense and pointless productions .
Please pay attention to these gag codes or emotions and play them.


■How to play =======
Lucky Stamina consists of 17 chapters, each of which gives you a choice.
Users can choose Kim Soo-yeon's choice to increase her favorability, or Hwang Jin-ah's choice to increase her favorability.
The game will feature two outdoor dating events and one forced date event, and the selection of outdoor dating events and the affinity of the heroine will determine the main ending.
Users can increase their affinity with the heroine and view the 8 endings through various challenges.

*This game is optimized for 1920*1080 (FHD) quality.


■How to operate =======
Left-click: Select and expand text
Mouse wheel: Rollback of previous and subsequent metabolism
Keyboard TAB Button: Skip Torque
Keyboard CTRL button: Skip
Keyboard SPACE button: Hide Metabolism

notes.title: 성우가 마침내 추가되었습니다 & 아트북 무료로 전환
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nL1-1DIyXvA;full][/previewyoutube]

안녕하세요, 유진게임즈입니다.

싸이코지라이 인 러브의 성우 추가 업데이트가 진행되었습니다.

참여해주신 성우는 김아롱 성우님입니다. 좋은 목소리를 내 주셔서 감사드립니다.

또한 보이스에 맞춰 많은 텍스트와 연출이 변경되었으니 이 점 참고 부탁드리겠습니다.


DLC 아트북은 성우 추가를 위한 모금의 목적으로 판매되었습니다.
성우 추가를 끝으로 해당 목적은 달성되었으며, 따라서 DLC 아트북을 무료로 전환하게 되었습니다.

DLC를 구매해주신 20분께 감사 인사를 건넵니다. 여러분의 성원은 분명 큰 도움이 되었을거라 믿습니다.

따라서, 해당 20분의 닉네임을 Thanks To. 란에 추가하고자 합니다.
2022년 7월 8일 (KST 기준) 무료로 풀리기 이전 구매해주신 분은 구매 인증(구매내역)을 첨부하여 
yujingamesc@gmail.com 으로 보내주세요.  원하는 닉네임을 함께 적어서 보내주시면, 차후 Thanks To. 란에 추가하여 업데이트를 진행하도록 하겠습니다. 감사합니다.


2022-07-09 간략 업데이트
* 유니티 프로그램 동시 실행 가능하도록 빌드 업데이트 완료. 
이제 타 프로그램을 실행중일 때도 해당 게임이 작동합니다.

* 일부 텍스트 수정

notes.title: Sponsored DLC sales to add voice actors
notes.content:
Yujin Games is always doing its best to show better performance.

I have gained various experiences over the past two years, and the purpose of this release is to add voice actor recording.

However, unlike small tasks so far, the addition of voice actors is somewhat burdensome. So I took the liberty of releasing DLC like this. 

The DLC has the following:

-Developer comments: 6 sheets
- CHAN's special illustration: 6 chapters
- In-game CG: 11 chapters
- In-game characters: 6 chapters
- In-game psychological expression: 1 sheet

Proceeds received from the DLC will be invested primarily at the additional cost of voice actors, and secondly at the production cost.

Although the quality is not good enough, I'm a little overdoing it because I'm afraid I'll never have a chance if it's not now.

I'd appreciate it if you could understand it with a wide range of generosity.




This DLC can be found by right-clicking Game List > Administration > View Local Files > Run "gotcha_artbook.exe" file.

notes.title: 싸이코지라이 인 러브가 출시되었습니다!
notes.content:

1. 유진게임즈 모든 게임 30% 할인. (8일 동안 진행)

2. 그 어느 여름날의 이야기 리마스터 완료. 

3. 그랑 엠파이어 아마네 3000원으로 가격 인하.

가 있겠습니다. 앞으로도 계속해서 발전해나가는 모습 보이도록 최선을 다하겠습니다. 감사합니다.
